test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct anwer is **Calamitious**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of '**Calamitious**' according to the English dictionary is '**Calamitous**'.
 
• The word '**Calamitous**' means '**involving calamity; catastrophic or disastrous**'.
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**Calamitious**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.
 
 
• **Quarrelsome**- given to or characterized by quarreling; argumentative.
 
• **Ecclesiastical**- relating to the Christian Church or its clergy.
 
• **Bovine**- relating to or affecting cattle.
